Usage: protonvpn cities [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Discover cities where servers are available in a specific country.

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  list  Shows a list of cities where servers are available in a specific
        country.

  Country Format:
    Two-letter code: US, GB, DE
    Full name: "United States", "Germany" (use quotes for multi-word)
  
  Examples:
    protonvpn cities list US               # Cities in US (direct argument)
    protonvpn cities list "United States"  # Full country name
  
  Connect to a city:
    protonvpn connect --city <CITY>
  
  To see available countries:
    protonvpn countries list
